SCOPE1.1   The material covered in this contract/purchase order will be used in a crucial shipboard system.  The use of incorrect or defective material would create a high probability of failure resulting in serious personnel injury, loss of life, loss of vitalshipboard systems, or loss of the ship itself.  Therefore, the material has been designated as SPECIAL EMPHASIS material (Level I, Scope of Certification, or Quality Assured) and special control procedures are invoked to ensure receipt of correct material.1.1.1   DSSP Scope of Certification Material  -  Material Control Division  ;(B);  applies to this material.2.
